svg.title: PayLink - Refund a failed payment (FAILED -> REFUNDED)

g.text: PayLink - Refund a failed payment (FAILED -> REFUNDED)
status FAILED, reason = biller error code
[UNKNOWN payment: reconciliation finds no payment (UNKNOWN -> FAILED)]
payment is not in the settlement file
status FAILED, reason = not received by biller
[UNKNOWN payment: Support confirms the biller refused (UNKNOWN -> FAILED, UC16)]
status FAILED, reason = confirmed by support
resolveUnknown works only on an UNKNOWN payment.
With CONFIRMED the payment becomes COMPLETED instead
2. Refund: hold released to the wallet (FAILED -> REFUNDED)
money returns only once the system is sure
the biller did not receive it.
COMPLETED, REJECTED and REFUNDED are final.
Hold status RELEASED, AuditLog entry (who, when, why)
The whole total comes back, including the fee:
the fee was only held, never earned.
No FEE_INCOME and no COMMISSION are posted.
3. Notification (does not change the result, hard case 5)
SMS and push with the clear reason (FR-22).
A failed send is retried 3 times, then marked UNDELIVERED.
Related: settlement file lists a payment PayLink has as FAILED (hard case 7)
Flagged in the ReconciliationReport for support to review.
The system does not change the payment or the wallet by itself.
